# 1 Enoch Chapter 105 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**105:1** I-and-my-son-will-be-joined-with-them-for-ever-in-the-paths-of-uprightness-in-their-lives; and-ye-shall-have-peace: rejoice, ye-children-of-uprightness. Amen.

**105:2** [Some manuscripts omit this verse. A variant text reads: And now I say unto you, sons of men: concerning that knowledge and wisdom, that in every generation ye shall love them and walk in the ways of all My creation; for God has set an end for all works, and what is given to your hearts shall be accomplished. And ye shall rejoice and have abundance, and love God, and He will keep you; and your heart shall be strengthened and your mouth shall be filled with praise, and ye shall praise God. And a parable is shown unto you of the Holy and Great One.]

---

*EMET notes: Ch. 105 is extremely short — possibly only v. 1 belongs to the original Epistle text. V. 1's "I and my son" refers to Enoch and possibly his son Methuselah, or to a messianic figure. "Paths of uprightness" closes a key phrase from the Epistle's opening (91:3–4). The "Amen" is unusual and may mark a liturgical close. V. 2 appears in some manuscripts as a later expansion and is bracketed as secondary. The chapter may be a transitional or closing fragment.*
